video.title: FOOTBALL DAILY'S EURO 2024 TEAM OF THE TOURNAMENT! | Sunday Vibes
video.description:
As Euro 2024 nears its end with a mouthwatering final between England and Spain in Berlin, Dougs and Michael take a look back at the last month to construct their team of the tournament!

Is Lamine Yamal the greatest teenager we've ever seen? Who out of Guehi, Pepe, Saliba, Akanji and Virgil Van Dijk made our centre-back pairings?And despite making the final do any of Gareth Southgate's squad deserve a spot in the XI?

And who misses out? With Saka, Nico Williams, Musiala and Wirtz all vying for spots on the wing.

And finally, what are our predictions for the final? Will England cause an upset or will Spain carry on their superb form in Germany? 

CHAPTERS

00:00-03:38 Intro + England Chat
03:38-07:07 Goalkeeper
07:07-11:23 Right-Back
11:23-21:33 Centre-Backs
21:33-26:57 Left-Back
26:57-34:54 Central Midfield
34:54-37:38 Attacking Midfield
37:38-43:03 Right Wing
43:03-44:40 Left Wing
44:40-50:46 Striker + Final Predictions!
